title: Instagram DM sales assistant for an online shoe store
metaTitle: Instagram DM sales assistant for a store | Pixel2Tech
metaDescription: An n8n Instagram DM assistant for an online shoe store that answers price and size questions, reserves a pair and confirms the order in the chat.
summary: An AI assistant that replies to Instagram direct messages for an online shoe store, answering price and size questions, reserving a pair and confirming the order in the same conversation.
overview: We built this assistant for an online shoe store that sells largely through Instagram. Every incoming DM is passed to n8n by webhook, where a shop assistant agent answers questions about prices, sizes and colors, reserves a pair when asked and walks the customer through confirming the order, then sends the reply back to Instagram.
challenge: Shoppers on Instagram expect quick answers in DMs. When a store owner replies hours later to a question about price or size, the customer has often moved on, and every reservation and order confirmation is typed by hand.
approach: A webhook receives each new DM. A shop assistant AI agent running on a Groq chat model reads the message, with simple memory so it keeps track of the conversation, such as the size and model the customer has already picked. The agent's instructions cover the store's products, prices, payment options and order steps. An HTTP request then sends the reply back to the customer through Instagram's messaging API.
outcome: Customers now get instant replies in Instagram DMs with prices and available sizes, and the assistant can reserve a pair and confirm the order before a person steps in to handle payment and shipping.
deliverables: Shop assistant agent with store instructions
Reply step through the Instagram messaging API

whyItMatters: In social selling, the store that answers first usually gets the sale, and an assistant that replies in seconds keeps buyers in the conversation.
